prompt.en: Two matched 10.8 V, 6 Ah packs are connected in series using equipment designed for that pack set. What is the resulting pack rating?

explanation.en: Series connection adds voltage while the ampere-hour rating stays that of one matched string.

prompt.en: A radio resets only on transmit when powered through a long thin DC cable. Which cause best fits?

text.en: Voltage drop in the DC leads
Too much receiver DSP noise reduction
An antenna that is too high

explanation.en: Transmit current is much higher than receive current, so undersized or long leads can drop enough voltage to reset the radio.

prompt.en: A compact switching supply powers the radio but a buzz appears across several bands. What is the most relevant comparison with a linear supply?

text.en: Linear supplies are always too small for transmitters
A linear supply may have lower RF-noise risk

explanation.en: A good switch-mode supply can work well, but a linear supply is often chosen when RF noise risk is the deciding factor.
